result.summary: The page appears visually intact with no critical or major broken elements. The layout follows standard mobile app design patterns. One minor observation is noted regarding the category filter row.

issues.description: The 'Healthy' category chip at the far right of the filter row is slightly clipped by the screen edge, indicating the row is horizontally scrollable but lacks a visual affordance (like a fade or arrow) to hint at more content.
issues.suggestion: Consider adding a subtle fade effect or a right-pointing chevron at the edge of the scrollable row to indicate to users that more categories are available.
